Market today: Jobs report blew expectations out of the water, sending yields higher. This is the main driver for your tech/chip names, which are sensitive to interest rate expectations.

Your holdings: SOXL is still a SELL at -53.79%. SPAL is a NEW position at -31.99% and needs watching. The rest are HOLDs, but SMH is down -10.58% and CRWD is up 20.2%.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 2-year yield, which is reacting to the jobs data. Also, watch for any follow-through on the Adobe CEO news.

Bottom line: The jobs report is the key event; watch how your leveraged names react to rising yields.
plays: SOXL: Trim or exit this leveraged ETF given its -53.79% loss and decay.
SPAL: Monitor this new leveraged ETF closely; its -31.99% loss is significant.
CRWD: Consider taking some profit if it pushes higher, given its 20.2% gain.
